title: Amplify ETFs Nominated for ETF Provider of the Year
author: Na
description: Amplify ETFs announced four nominations across three categories in the With Intelligence Mutual Fund and ETF Awards, including ETF Provider of the Year. The company's blockchain, junior silver miners, and growth & income ETFs were recognized for their performance and innovation. Winners will be announced on February 11, 2026.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: BLOK received a nomination for Alternative ETF of the Year and holds a 5-star Morningstar rating. The fund demonstrated exceptional performance with 32.95% YTD return and 269.59% return since inception, positioning it as an early leader in blockchain investment exposure.

SILJ received a nomination for Alternative ETF of the Year and delivered strong performance with 184.02% YTD return as of 12/31/2025, demonstrating successful execution of its niche investment strategy in small-cap silver mining.

QDVO received a nomination for Sales Success of the Year, indicating strong investor flows and market traction. The fund delivered 20.25% YTD return with an 11.20% distribution rate, showing successful execution of its covered call strategy.

title: Silver Stocks Are Caught In A Hype Loop, Warns Senior Mining Analyst: Investors Could Face 'Liquidity' Issues And Dangerous Exit Conditions Ahead
author: Vishaal Sanjay
description: A senior mining analyst warns that silver stocks are experiencing unsustainable hype with valuations disconnected from fundamentals. Many junior miners lack operational success and carry debt, yet continue rallying with silver prices. The analyst cautions that rapid unwinding could create dangerous liquidity issues when prices turn. However, silver's underlying momentum remains strong with experts predicting continued upside in 2026.

title: Peter Schiff Says Silver Investors Are In 'Denial' As Mining Stocks Continue To Lag: 'Should Have Doubled' In December
author: Vishaal Sanjay
description: Economist Peter Schiff criticizes the disconnect between silver's 35% December surge and silver mining stocks' modest 11% gain, arguing mining stocks should have doubled given their typical leveraged exposure to the metal. Despite silver's historic rally and 154.57% year-to-date gains, major mining stocks and ETFs have significantly underperformed, presenting what Schiff views as an attractive buying opportunity.

title: Silver Crushes Gold With 152% Rally—Here's What You Should Know About The Tight Supply Story And Backwardation
author: Vishaal Sanjay
description: Silver has rallied 152% year-to-date, its strongest performance since 1978, driven by industrial demand and a structural supply deficit. The market is experiencing backwardation due to tight physical supplies, with China's export restrictions adding further pressure. Analysts predict prices could test $85-$100 per ounce as deficits widen, benefiting both silver producers and junior miners.
